name: sleek
description: Design mobile app screens with Sleek's hosted MCP server (https://sleek.design/api/mcp): create projects, run Sleek's design agent from a description of your app, show or render the screens, and fetch each screen's HTML to build from. Design runs spend your Sleek workspace's AI credits.

design.note: about 30 per new screen, 5 to 30 per edit
